The current real-time AQI (US) level in Rabat is 25 (Good). This was last updated 2026-11-23 21:01 (Local Time).

2\. When was the best AQI (US) level in Rabat in the last 24 hours?

The best AQI (US) level was 6 (Good) at 2:01 AM, Nov 23, 2026 (Local Time) during the last 24 hours.

3\. When was the worst AQI (US) level in Rabat in the last 24 hours?

The worst AQI (US) level was 42 (Good) at 8:31 PM, Nov 23, 2026 (Local Time) during the last 24 hours.

4\. What is the current trend of AQI (US) levels in Rabat during last 24 hours?

The AQI (US) levels in Rabat have been fluctuating throughout the last 24 hours. The levels have increased by highest 42 at 8:31 PM, Nov 23, 2026 (Local Time), lowest 6 at 2:01 AM, Nov 23, 2026 (Local Time).

5\. What actions are recommended as per the current AQI (US) level in Rabat?

The air quality is satisfactory, and air pollution poses little or no risk. No special precautions are needed; enjoy outdoor activities freely.
